description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigProvider class in C#, responsible for resolving the application's Postgres connection string from configuration sources such as appsettings, environment variables, or environment URL formats. It includes methods for attempting to retrieve and normalize different connection string formats and provides a result record to indicate success or failure.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides resolution of the Postgres database connection string from configuration sources.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of attempting to resolve a database connection string, including success, failure, and error details.

methods.name: TryResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a normalized Postgres connection string from the configuration.

methods.name: Configured
methods.description: Static method to create a successful resolution result with a connection string.

methods.name: NotConfigured
methods.description: Static method to create a resolution result indicating no configuration was found.

methods.name: FromError
methods.description: Static method to create a resolution result indicating an error occurred during parsing.
